paper_cards.title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
paper_cards.data: Molmo 2-ER reasoning corpus, MolmoAct2-Bimanual YAM, filtered DROID Franka, SO100/101, Bridge, and Open X-Embodiment-derived robot data.
paper_cards.method: Embodied-reasoning VLM with a KV-cache bridge to a flow-matching action expert, adaptive-depth reasoning, and an open action tokenizer.
paper_cards.task: Open real-world robot manipulation with reasoning-heavy single-arm and bimanual control.
paper_cards.novelty: Combines open embodied reasoning, open action tokenization, low-cost/bimanual data, and broad release artifacts into a deployment-oriented VLA stack.
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract and official Ai2 release jointly provide architecture, dataset scale, code/data release status, simulation metrics, real-world metrics, and qualitative robot evidence.

claim_checks.claim: Molmo 2-ER is trained on an additional ~3.3M embodied-reasoning examples.
MolmoAct2-Bimanual YAM is the largest open-source bimanual dataset with more than 700 to 720 hours of demonstrations.
claim_checks.notes: Official blog release states the size and release framing.

claim_checks.claim: Full code, training data, and LeRobot integration are publicly released.

paper_cards.limitations: Official release is still concentrated on supported embodiments and batchwise planning rather than universal reactive control.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong open baseline for reasoning-to-action transfer, bimanual manipulation, and low-cost embodiment deployment.

paper_cards.title: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
paper_cards.data: Expanded embodied world-model benchmark with visuotactile, simulated, and real-world evaluation surfaces plus public leaderboard infrastructure.
paper_cards.method: Benchmark extension that evaluates world models across modality, functionality, and platform with perceptual metrics and downstream embodied utility tests.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, data engines, policy evaluators, action planners, and interactive RL environments.
paper_cards.novelty: Extends WorldArena from vision-only simulator-centric evaluation toward visuotactile, policy-optimization, and cross-platform embodied testing.
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract plus the official benchmark site jointly document the expansion axes, functional evaluation roles, and public benchmark infrastructure.

claim_checks.claim: WorldArena 2.0 extends modality to visuotactile signals, functionality to interactive RL environments, and platform to real-world evaluation.
The official benchmark site exposes leaderboard, dataset, challenge, and submission surfaces.
Perceptual evaluation includes 16 metrics across 6 sub-dimensions.
claim_checks.notes: Visible in the Overview and Evaluation Framework sections.

paper_cards.limitations: Public benchmark surfaces may evolve; exact protocol freeze dates should be checked before using leaderboard comparisons longitudinally.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct evaluation target for closed-loop embodied generation, world-action models, and simulator-backed policy learning.

paper_cards.title: Embodied3DBench: Benchmarking Low-Level Embodied Spatial Intelligence of Vision Language Models
paper_cards.data: Robot-centric embodied 3D benchmark with 6 task categories, 12 subcategories, 21k+ QA pairs, and a 1.3M-pair synthetic training set.
paper_cards.method: Diagnostic benchmark plus synthetic QA training data for low-level embodied spatial intelligence.
paper_cards.task: Benchmark low-level embodied spatial understanding and interaction-oriented perception for VLMs.
paper_cards.novelty: Separates structural spatial understanding from interaction-oriented perception and pairs diagnosis with a large synthetic improvement set.
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract provides clear task taxonomy, scale, model-count, and synthetic-data claims sufficient for benchmark acceptance.

claim_checks.claim: The benchmark contains 6 task categories and 12 subcategories.
The benchmark spans over 21k QA pairs and an additional 1.3M synthetic QA training set.

paper_cards.limitations: No separate official project/code page was recovered during this run, so deeper release details should be rechecked before citing operational availability.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful low-level benchmark for grounding, affordance, grasp-point, and trajectory-perception checks in generated or reconstructed worlds.

paper_cards.title: ESPIRE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
paper_cards.data: Isaac-Sim-based embodied spatial reasoning benchmark with 148 localization reasoning types and functional-program-generated scene-graph targets.
paper_cards.method: Fully generative localization-plus-execution benchmark for embodied spatial reasoning in simulation.
paper_cards.task: Diagnose action-oriented embodied spatial reasoning of VLMs under physically grounded execution settings.
paper_cards.novelty: Turns spatial reasoning evaluation from static QA into a physically grounded generative localization and execution problem.
paper_cards.evidence: The accessible arXiv abstract and HTML text make the localization/execution split, Isaac Sim grounding, and task-systematicity explicit.

claim_checks.claim: ESPIRE is a fully generative benchmark covering localization and execution.
claim_checks.notes: Stated in the abstract and accessible HTML text.

claim_checks.claim: The benchmark covers 148 spatial-reasoning types for localization.
claim_checks.notes: Visible in the accessible HTML text.

claim_checks.claim: Task instructions are represented as functional programs executed on 3D scene graphs.
claim_checks.notes: Visible in the accessible HTML text.

paper_cards.limitations: No separate project/code page was confirmed during this run; benchmark availability should be rechecked before downstream use.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong validator template for reasoning-to-act spatial competence in interactive embodied generation systems.

paper_cards.title: GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation
paper_cards.data: Thousands of hours of real-world robot data spanning teleoperation, contact-rich interaction, and on-robot policy deployment according to the abstract.
paper_cards.method: Closed-loop video world simulator with a state expert, a world judge, and accelerated rollout inference.
paper_cards.task: Closed-loop policy development and evaluation for robotic manipulation through action-conditioned video rollouts.
paper_cards.novelty: Moves a robotic video world simulator toward practical policy-learning loops rather than offline video prediction alone.
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract is strong enough to justify review, but the run could not recover official demo/code surfaces needed for confident visual acceptance.

claim_checks.claim: The method adds a state expert, world judge, and acceleration framework.
It tops the public WorldArena leaderboard at 2B parameters.
claim_checks.notes: Source-reported in abstract; not independently checked during this run.

paper_cards.limitations: Generation-heavy acceptance depends on qualitative rollout quality, which could not be judged confidently from primary official materials recovered in this run.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Potentially strong world-simulator addition if rollout quality and controllability clear the demo bar.

paper_cards.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
paper_cards.data: A reported 15B-token embodied data system plus downstream VLA finetuning and embodied-benchmark evaluation.
paper_cards.method: Unified embodied foundation model with a Planner-Grounder-Corrector loop and multi-task balanced RL recipe.
paper_cards.task: Embodied reasoning with transfer into VLA-style robot manipulation.
paper_cards.novelty: Claims to unify broad embodied reasoning and downstream VLA adaptation in one open EFM release.
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract is promising and relevant, but the run did not recover official demo or release surfaces needed to accept real-robot claims confidently.

claim_checks.claim: The model uses a 15B-token embodied data system and a Planner-Grounder-Corrector closed loop.
Weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit are open-sourced.
claim_checks.notes: Claimed in the abstract, but no official artifact URLs were confirmed in this run.

paper_cards.limitations: Robot-demo-heavy acceptance depends on official visual evidence and release confirmation that were not available from primary/official sources recovered in this run.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Likely strong if confirmed, especially for bridging embodied reasoning and downstream VLA capability.
